verdicts.reason: Both 320×50 banners have the same layout. The descriptive copy and venue line are crammed into a microscopic block on the right, the pills are tiny, and the RSVP CTA is shrunk to an illegible sliver below the date, so the call to action is buried. The date competes with the headline, and the product illustration has been dropped. B at least keeps the white Solstice logo above the headline. In A the logo is missing or barely visible, which weakens brand fidelity.
